youtube.baslik: Why does the same hearing aid sound louder in a baby's ear? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: Because an infant's ear canal is short and narrow, the same sound creates higher sound pressure in the small volume; the difference is largest at high frequencies and varies between children. The real-ear-to-coupler difference (RECD) is found with a measurement of a few seconds, and the rest of the fitting is done in the test box.
